subject: Shift-left runtime headcount authorization: Edge Runtime capacity request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, sam@contingentstaffing.com
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Shift-left runtime headcount authorization: Edge Runtime capacity request

Team —

We need to greenlight additional headcount in the runtime/infra org to meet the RealTime API v2 launch and the new Edge-focused SLAs. Summary ask: 3 FTEs (2 Runtime Engineers, 1 Platform/SRE) starting in Q3, plus a 3-month contractor to cover onboarding and capacity while hiring completes.

Why now (short):
- Product committed higher concurrency + 2x token throughput; current pools operate near sustained capacity during business hours.
- We have rolling outages risk if we don't increase runway; expected MTTR will rise without dedicated infra staff.
- This is required to deliver the v2 global region rollout planned for Q4.

Budget ask: see attached hc-budget-spreadsheet.xlsx; ballpark incremental fully-loaded cost = $1.05M run-rate.

Comp bands note: one of the Runtime hires should be a Staff/Principal-level hire (we propose Staff Runtime, band midpoint corresponds to Band 7). Recruiting signals that to secure the profile we may need a comp-band exception up to $280k total cash for that role (current band cap is $250k). I put a proposed exception justification in the attached comp-bands-q2.pdf.

Immediate asks:
1) Approval to open 3 reqs + contingency contractor (sam@contingentstaffing.com linked for scoping).
2) Tentative approval for a single comp-band exception (Staff Runtime) subject to final sign-off from finance/comp committee.
3) Any red flags if we reallocate an open infra headcount from Platform Tools (internal reorg) instead of new HC?

I can be on the deck at 10:30 if anyone wants a 15-min sync.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Dir, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hc-budget-spreadsheet.xlsx (Excel, 34KB), comp-bands-q2.pdf (PDF, 210KB), org-heatmap.png (PNG, 160KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shift-left runtime headcount authorization: Edge Runtime capacity request

Ben —

Thanks for the clear summary. A couple quick items before I sign off:
- Can you break the $1.05M into comp vs one-time ramp (contractor, tooling, infra)? I want to see the FY27 run-rate impact separately.
- For the comp band exception, what's the downside if we split the Staff hire into a Senior + a Staff (i.e., hire two mid-senior engineers instead)? Will that increase ramp time significantly?
- I'm open to contractor cover for 12 weeks if we scope clear deliverables. Please loop in vendor (sam@contingentstaffing.com) to confirm availability and day rates.

If we have the #s this afternoon I can do a quick approval.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP Engineering, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, sam@contingentstaffing.com, emma.jones@talentflow.io
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shift-left runtime headcount authorization: Edge Runtime capacity request

Marcus —

Attached is a short breakdown (pulled from hc-budget-spreadsheet.xlsx):
- Run-rate comp (3 FTE): $780k fully-burdened
- Contractor (3 months): $60k (vendor day-rate at $1,400/day; includes 2x on-call overlap weeks)
- One-time tooling/provisioning and onboarding: $40k
- Contingency & hiring overhead (recruiting, signing, equipment): $170k
Total: $1.05M first-year impact; FY28 ongoing run-rate: ~$880k.

Band-splitting option: If we hire 2 Senior Runtime + 1 Platform SRE (instead of 1 Staff + 2 Senior), we expect a 6–10 week longer ramp for key architecture deliverables (stateful cache migration, KV cache sizing), which pushes the v2 rollout by ~1 sprint on our current plan. The Staff hire buys us senior technical leadership and deeper low-latency kernel tuning experience; it's a force-multiplier for reducing token cost and tail-latency.

Vendor availability: sam@contingentstaffing.com confirms a contractor available mid-May with start aligned to our ramp (vendor confirmed in attached vendor quote, sent separately). Day rate and SOW delivered to Lauren/Dev for procurement.

If you want, I can reframe the ask as 2 new HC + 1 reallocated HC from Platform Tools and a contractor; that saves $220k run-rate but reduces dedicated infra ownership.

Proposed decision path:
- Approve opening 3 reqs + contractor (recruiter to start pipeline) — immediate.
- Give tentative comp exception for one Staff role up to $280k — final sign-off via finance.
- If comp exception denied, fallback: split into Senior + Senior (no headcount increase).

Happy to sketch an exec one-pager for finance review this afternoon.

Ben
Dir, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shift-left runtime headcount authorization: Edge Runtime capacity request

Thanks for the detail, Ben. A couple HR items before comp exceptions move forward:

1) Market comp evidence: Please attach at least two external benchmarks (cited comp surveys or two recent offers for similar roles) supporting $280k ask. The comp-bands-q2.pdf helps but we need current-market datapoints.
2) Level and role description: Submit a short role profile (6 bullets) to justify Staff vs Senior. HR needs the scope for leveling and benching.
3) Approval flow: After VP approval we route the comp exception to the Comp Committee (cc: Finance) for final. If Finance objects, HR will provide alternatives (sign-on, equity refresh, or split role).

On the contractor: we prefer contracting through our preferred partners. If sam@contingentstaffing.com will place through our master vendor, send the SOW to procurement and copy me.

Happy to expedite once the two items above are in.

Best,
Monica Patel
Sr. Manager, Talent Acquisition (Engineering)
Redwood Inference

Ben/Marcus/Monica —

I've reviewed the numbers and risks. Approved: open 3 reqs (2 Runtime Engineers, 1 Platform SRE) and engage contractor for 12 weeks pending procurement quote. Conditional approval for comp-band exception: authorize pursuit of Staff-level candidate at total cash up to $275k while we assemble the market evidence for the remaining $5k. Finance will need the one-pager.

Please action:
- Ben: circulate the 1-page justification (role bullets + impact metrics) and attach two market comps by EOD tomorrow.
- Lauren/Dev: prepare procurement ticket for contractor SOW and vendor placement.
- Monica: queue comp exception packet to Comp Committee (cc finance) once Ben shares benchmarks.

I expect a final sign-off by mid-week if paperwork is complete. Good work putting this together — the Edge region SLAs are a high priority and we should staff accordingly.

Laura Bennett
Head of Platform
Redwood Inference
